scenes.headline: How a fruit-fly circuit becomes a speech classifier
scenes.sub: Reservoir computing on real wiring, and the control that tests it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Badger! One team wired four hundred and ninety-nine real fruit-fly neurons into a speech-emotion classifier. Here's how it works.

scenes.text: Only a linear readout is trained. The fixed fly circuit is a reservoir, and its spectral radius, not its wiring, does the work.
scenes.say: The idea: only a linear readout learns. The fly circuit is a fixed reservoir, and one number, its spectral radius, does the work.

steps.say: Voice audio becomes thirty-two log-mel bands.

steps.note: wired from the MaleCNS connectome; never trained
steps.say: A fixed random projection feeds them into four hundred and ninety-nine real fly neurons. Nothing here is ever trained.
Each clip's activity is summarized as four temporal means. A separate branch of pooled audio features skips the circuit entirely.
One ridge regression maps all of it to thirty-one listener labels. That readout is the only thing that learns.

scenes.title: A leaky echo state network
scenes.say: The circuit is a leaky echo state network.

parts.note: each neuron keeps part of its previous state; α = 0.15
parts.say: Each neuron keeps most of its own previous state.

parts.note: fly wiring: sign x log(1 + contacts), rescaled
parts.say: It adds its neighbours through the fly wiring, rescaled so the spectral radius is point nine.

scenes.title: Why the radius sits just under 1

left.title: Radius past 1
items: The network chews on its own history
A readout has no reason to generalize
left.say: Past a radius of one, starting states never converge. The network chews on its own history.

right.title: Radius 0.9
items: State depends only on recent input
right.say: Just under one, it forgets where it started, so its state tracks the input.

scenes.title: Mean average precision over 31 labels
scenes.note: fly versus scrambled: a tie within noise
scenes.say: The control: fly wiring scored sixteen point eight four. Scrambled wiring, sixteen point eight eight. A tie. Any recurrence beats none; which one doesn't matter.

scenes.text: A linear readout sees a reservoir's statistics, not its identity.
scenes.say: So a linear readout sees a reservoir's statistics, not its identity.

recap: A fixed fly circuit, a random input, one ridge readout
Spectral radius 0.9 keeps the echo state property
Scrambled wiring ties the real thing
scenes.say: To recap: a fixed circuit, a radius just under one, and a readout that can't tell real wiring from scrambled.
